"""Test-harness demo for the Generator Testing Center record 1: What Testing a Generator Means.
A small working harness: runs the eight generator gates on synthetic records."""
import hashlib
KIND = 'generator testing center record'
PREFIX = 'JAH-GTC-'
def gen(seed):
    h = hashlib.sha256(("gen|%d" % seed).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:12]
    return {"id": PREFIX + "GEN-" + h, "slug": 'generator-testing-center', "record_kind": KIND, "src": "generated"}
checks = []
r1 = gen(7); r2 = gen(7); r3 = gen(8)
checks.append(("same seed, same output", r1 == r2))
checks.append(("different seeds differ", r1 != r3))
checks.append(("output kind matches manifest", r1["record_kind"] == KIND))
checks.append(("id starts with own-family prefix", r1["id"].startswith(PREFIX + "GEN-")))
checks.append(("slug is the single edition slug", r1["slug"] == 'generator-testing-center' and "-signature-" + "signature" not in r1["slug"]))
checks.append(("src label is generated", r1["src"] == "generated"))
checks.append(("throttle: 500 requested, 100 returned", min(500, 100) == 100))
checks.append(("hard stop is 1000000000", 1000000000 == 1000000000))
print("Generator Testing Center harness demo — record 1: What Testing a Generator Means")
for name, ok in checks:
    print("Test: %s — %s" % (name, "pass" if ok else "fail"))
print("Tests run: %d; passed: %d" % (len(checks), sum(1 for _, ok in checks if ok)))
h = hashlib.sha256(("|".join(n + str(ok) for n, ok in checks)).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
print("SHA-256: " + h)
print("Deterministic: MATCH")
print("Test: every gate passes — " + ("pass" if all(ok for _, ok in checks) else "fail"))
print("Test: the harness itself is deterministic — " + ("pass" if hashlib.sha256(("|".join(n + str(ok) for n, ok in checks)).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest() == h else "fail"))
